db.open.doc: A Database on PostgreSQL service database-postgres: new Database(new Postgres(PDO), Cache) with its own Authorization (roles, default ["any"]), setDatabase(database ?? ${ns}), setSharedTables, setTenant, setTenantPerDocument, setNamespace(namespace ?? "compat") and create() (unless create: false). Args: namespace?, database?, shared_tables?, tenant?, tenant_per_document?, pool? ({"size": n} (default 1) for a Utopia\Database\Adapter\Pool over a Utopia\Pools\Pool of PostgreSQL connections from a Stack, waiting 0 s, with a connection of its own for db.sql; "unreachable": true makes every connection attempt fail as a refused connection; {"of": <handle>} the pool of another Pool database), redis? (true: a Utopia\Database\Adapter\Redis over service database-redis-adapter instead of PostgreSQL, no db.sql), mirror? ({destination?: bool (default true: a Database on PostgreSQL service database-postgres-mirror with cache `cache` (default redis-mirror, flushed)), filters?: [names of Mirroring\Filter fixtures: "log" logs each hook it runs to db.log as {"mirroring": <hook>, "collection", ...} and passes its input through], cache?}: a Utopia\Database\Mirror over a source on this adapter and that destination), cache?: "memory"|"none"|"redis"|"redis-mirror"|"redis-shared" (Redis caches through Utopia\Cache\Adapter\Redis, Json entries, igbinary ones with an "-igbinary" suffix; redis and redis-mirror are private to each runtime and flushed when a database of its own opens, redis-shared is one both runtimes use), create?, roles?, adapter? (a database handle: a peer on its adapter, not made current), engine?: "postgres"|"sqlite"|"memory"|"mongo" (new SQLite(PDO) on file /tmp/compat-fs/${ns}/<file ?? "database.sqlite">, with setEmulateMySQL(emulate_mysql ?? false); new Memory(); new Mongo(client) on service database-mongo, setSupportForAttributes(!schemaless)), detached? (a fresh adapter of engine in a database neither made current nor set up), driver?: "postgres"|"mariadb"|"mysql" (new MariaDB(PDO)/new MySQL(PDO) on service database-mariadb/database-mysql instead of PostgreSQL). With engine sqlite or memory only the default caches (memory, none) apply. Returns a handle; the database becomes the current one.

db.pool.doc: The pool of a Pool database, seen from outside its adapter: method opened (connections its init opened, attempts included), count (idle connections), timeout (getTimeout() of the connection a raw checkout gets), clear (clearTimeouts() on that connection), pinned_timeout (getTimeout() of the connection a transaction pinned, null without)

db.cache.doc: A method of the database's Cache (Utopia\Cache\Cache): method load|save|save_with_lease|get_generation|touch|list|purge, args by name (key, ttl, hash, data, generation). Saves report whether they stored

db.select.doc: Makes the database `db` (a handle) the current one; true

db.adapter.doc: $db->getAdapter()->{method}(...args): any public adapter method (capabilities, limits, raw adapter calls), named arguments as database.*

db.log.doc: The entries fixtures logged since the last db.log (listener events, filter calls, transformations), in order; clears them

db.sql.doc: A statement on the database's own connection, naming no schema but the database's: rows as lists of column => text

db.memory_data.doc: The stored collections of the database's Memory adapter (its `$data`, which MemoryTest reads by reflection): storage key => attributes, indexes, documents, sequence

db.add_format.doc: Structure::addFormat(name, ...) with the named fixture format of the e2e suite (priceRange, priceRangeNew: a Range from formatOptions min/max, integer); true

db.mirror.doc: A part of a Mirror database (from outside it): part source|destination, the Database it wraps as a handle (null without a destination)

db.redis.doc: A raw command (a list of strings) on the database of the Redis adapter (service database-redis-adapter), keys naming the case namespace only: corrupts state behind the adapter; null

database.on_error.doc: $mirror->onError(callback): registers a callback named `name` (default "error") logging each destination failure to db.log as {"mirror": <action>, "callback", "error"}; null

database.get_destination.doc: $mirror->getDestination(): {"$database": true}, or null without a destination

database.create_upgrades.doc: $mirror->createUpgrades(): creates the source-only `upgrades` collection unless it exists; null

scrub.reason: documents carry the time they were written ($createdAt, $updatedAt, _createdAt, ...); the e2e suite also writes datetimes a day around now. Within 50 hours of the runner clock they read <now>
ID::unique() makes ids from the clock and random bytes when a document has no $id
the e2e suite's 14 MB longtext.txt documents stay out of the case files: long strings compare by length and SHA-256
